items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I made another album Monmouth-Evergreen with Dick Hyman

ctx.x: So he really didn't know me. So after we did the Music Of Hoagy Carmichael then I did the album Closest Pages In A Book, and I used a small combination under the direction of Bob Wilber. And then I made another album Monmouth-Evergreen with Dick Hyman. Dick Hyman had been on that earlier album, the Andy Razaff album along with some other little things I had done here and there. And Dick had, what can I say, composed some music to some Shakespear lyrics, just some stray little pieces. And Dick said because he had…
Okay. There are two other things
